title: Passive Cell Balancing
text: 无源电池单体均衡算法，输入 2 路、输出 2 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Threshold for balancing} 指定均衡阈值、{Hysteresis band for switching balancing off} 关闭无源均衡的迟滞带、{ON delay time (s)} 指定均衡激活前的时间延迟、{OFF delay time (s)} 指定均衡完成后的时间延迟、{Command Data Type} 指定 Command 输出的数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: u
ports.summary: 电池单体电压或电池单体 SOC 值 vector

ports.name: Enable
ports.summary: 是否启用电池单体均衡 scalar

ports.name: BalancingActive
ports.summary: 均衡过程是否处于活动状态 scalar

params.name: Hysteresis band for switching balancing off
params.values: 关闭无源均衡的迟滞带 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: ON delay time (s)
params.values: 均衡激活前的时间延迟 1 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: OFF delay time (s)
params.values: 均衡完成后的时间延迟 1 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive integer

params.name: Command Data Type
params.values: Command 输出的数据类型 double (default) | single | boolean |
